items.title: 3 US Defense Stocks Worth Watching As Nvidia Questions Hit National Security
items.summary: Nvidia’s boardroom drama, with CEO Jensen Huang under investigation after admitting an extramarital affair tied to an alleged intelligence-linked sting, has pushed national security risk from the policy pages onto your portfolio screen. Scrutiny of Nvidia’s China links and AI exports could change who wins and loses across defense and security technology. This piece unpacks three stocks exposed to that story, and why their next chapter matters for you. The stocks covered below are just a small...
